_about: Apple Support style, measured from 3 Apple Support videos at 1920x1080. Ryo's choices win where they conflict: Myriad Pro (Apple uses voice-over), gentle zoom factors; horizontal title cards on the left, vertical captions under the phone.

layout._note: h: the opening title is Apple's left title card at full title size (cap height ~6.3% of 1080 = 100px Myriad) with the MacBook pushed right at its wide-shot size; in-app steps keep the MacBook centred with captions under it. v: hero title, then captions under the phone.

move._note: one curve for every zoom, device move, text slide, push and wipe

transition._note: steps within an app change in place on the same device; the grey panel wipe is only for new-app cutscenes

zoom._note: fewer zooms with long holds; each step's caption is settled ~1 s before the device moves in
